videoTitle: Your Birth Control Might Be Changing Your Mood—Here's the Part Doctors Skip
videoDescription: Feeling flatter or more anxious since starting the pill? It's not in your head. The research shows mood changes are real—but the type of hormone matters more than anyone tells you. Find out which progestins are linked to worse mood outcomes at mindtivate.com.
script: You've been told birth control mood changes are all in your head. They're not—but it's not about 'the pill' as one thing. It's actually about which specific progestin you're on, and some are linked to way worse mood outcomes than others...
Visit mindtivate.com to find out which ones.
thumbnailConcept: A woman sits on the edge of her bed in the dim morning light, looking down at a birth control blister pack in her hands with a look of quiet exhaustion and frustration, one hand rubbing her forehead as she struggles with unexplained mood swings.
